name: Awardco
summary: Awardco's pricing page says starter packages start at $3,000 for businesses with 100 employees or less. Advanced, Premier and Enterprise have no published price. The page says the catalog builder, points management with expiration and advanced reporting are in every plan, with one exception it does not name.

facts.text: Spot is one of the recognition types. Standard lets buyers choose any 2 recognition types, Advanced any 3, Premier any 4, and Enterprise has access to all of them. The page does not say which plans include Spot.
According to the vendor's page, the catalog builder, points management with expiration and advanced reporting are available in every plan, with one exception it does not name.
HRIS Sync is sold as a premium add-on. The page does not say whether any plan includes it.
The visible plan cards and the page's structured data use different plan names. The per-year billing period and USD currency for the $3,000 starting price appear only in the structured data.
Per the vendor's page, user authentication and SSO are listed among the capabilities in every plan, with the same unnamed exception.

plans.name: Service Awards and Automated Plus
plans.notes: Starting pricing for businesses with 100 employees or less. The per-year billing period and USD currency appear only in the page's structured data

plans.name: Standard
